name: Team Charmander: Prehistoric Meltdown & Thunderous Offense
archetype: Fire wallbreaking, Electric anti-air, and Ground/Fighting physical breaker.
gym_duel_rationale: Super Nerd Miguel's fossil lineup meets comprehensive type coverage: Charizard/Venusaur melts Aron/Sableye and Lairon/Medicham with Flamethrower, while Petal Dance scores an effortless 4x knockout on Kabutops/Omastar; Gyarados/Nidoking uses Intimidate to blunt Aerodactyl's physical power on switch-in, washing rock beasts away with Aqua Tail; Alakazam/Raichu electrocutes Tyrantrum/Dragonite and Aerodactyl with high-speed Thunderbolt; Primeape/Sandslash crushes Aron/Sableye with STAB Earthquake and breaks steel with Close Combat; and Snorlax walls heavy hits with Rest and Leftovers.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor at Cap 63. Petal Dance annihilates Kabutops/Omastar. Flamethrower melts Aron/Sableye and Lairon/Medicham.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes Aerodactyl's 105 Attack on switch-in. Aqua Tail and Earth Power wash away rock and steel foes.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt electrocutes Tyrantrum/Dragonite and Aerodactyl. STAB Psychic strikes Lairon/Medicham.
477 BST wallbreaker. Vital Spirit prevents sleep. STAB Earthquake crumbles Aron/Sableye and rock foes; Close Combat smashes steel.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray fossil attacks comfortably, recovering to full health with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Ice Beam cleanly freezes Tyrantrum/Dragonite and Aerodactyl across excavation chambers.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and Roost recovery.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
Iron Fist-boosted Thunder Punch and Ice Punch for versatile tech coverage.
